standards.title: Prefer managed and serverless services
standards.statement: New workloads should use managed or serverless services from the Approved Service Catalog before self-managed compute. Self-managed EC2 requires a documented exception.
requirements: Select services with status 'approved' or 'approved_with_constraints' in the Approved Service Catalog.
Document an exception for any self-managed server fleet.
Use infrastructure as code for all environments.

standards.title: Single-region multi-AZ by default
standards.statement: To limit cost and complexity, workloads deploy to a single region across at least two Availability Zones unless the Disaster Recovery standard requires a multi-region posture.
requirements: Deploy across at least two Availability Zones.
Do not add a second region unless the availability target or STD-DR-001 requires it.

standards.title: Least-privilege workload identities
standards.statement: Every workload component uses its own IAM role scoped to specific actions and resources. Wildcard actions on production resources are prohibited. Long-lived access keys are prohibited for workloads.
requirements: One IAM role per component; no shared roles across components.
No '*' actions on data-plane resources.
No long-lived IAM user access keys in application code or configuration.

standards.title: Workforce and customer authentication
standards.statement: Human users authenticate through an approved identity provider. Applications handling confidential or restricted data require multi-factor authentication and session timeouts of 60 minutes or less.
requirements: Use an approved identity provider (catalog SVC-COGNITO or the enterprise IdP).
MFA required for confidential and restricted data.
Session lifetime at most 60 minutes for confidential and restricted data.

standards.title: Encryption in transit
standards.statement: All network traffic uses TLS 1.2 or later. Public endpoints use certificates issued by an approved certificate authority such as AWS Certificate Manager.
requirements: TLS 1.2+ on every hop.
Use ACM-issued certificates for public endpoints.
HSTS on browser-facing sites.

standards.title: Encryption at rest with managed keys
standards.statement: Data at rest is encrypted. Confidential and restricted data use customer-managed KMS keys with annual rotation and key policies limited to the owning workload.
requirements: Encrypt all storage at rest.
Customer-managed KMS key (SVC-KMS) for confidential and restricted data.
Enable automatic key rotation.

standards.title: Centralized structured logging and retention
standards.statement: Applications emit structured JSON logs with a correlation ID to CloudWatch Logs. Security-relevant logs are retained for 400 days.
requirements: Structured JSON logs with correlation IDs.
Retain security and audit logs for 400 days.
Enable CloudTrail data events for restricted data stores.

standards.title: Monitoring, alarms, and tracing
standards.statement: Production workloads publish service metrics, alarms on error rate and latency, and distributed tracing across service boundaries.
requirements: Alarms on error rate and p95 latency.
Distributed tracing (X-Ray or OpenTelemetry).
Operational dashboard per workload.

standards.title: Personal data minimization
standards.statement: Collect only personal data needed for the stated purpose. Workloads that process personal data complete a privacy impact assessment before production.
requirements: Complete a privacy impact assessment (PIA) for personal data.
Document purpose and lawful basis for each personal data element.
Mask or tokenize personal data in non-production environments.

standards.title: No personal data in logs; 30-day limit
standards.statement: Logs must not contain personal data. Where personal data cannot be excluded from a log stream, that stream is retained no longer than 30 days.
requirements: Redact personal data before logging.
Log streams that may contain personal data: retention 30 days or less.

standards.title: Generative AI use governance
standards.statement: Generative AI features use catalog-approved model platforms, register the use case, keep a human accountable for decisions, and label AI-generated output as advisory.
requirements: Use an approved model platform (SVC-BEDROCK).
Register the AI use case with the Responsible AI Council.
Label AI output as advisory; no fully automated decisions affecting customers.
Do not send restricted data to a model without an approved data-handling review.

standards.title: AI safety controls: grounding, injection defense, evaluation
standards.statement: Generative AI applications ground answers in approved sources, defend against prompt injection in user input and retrieved content, filter harmful output, and run evaluations before release.
requirements: Ground responses in approved, cited sources.
Treat user input and retrieved content as untrusted; detect prompt injection.
Apply content filtering (for example Bedrock Guardrails).
Run an offline evaluation set before each release.

standards.title: Availability tiers and recovery objectives
standards.statement: Workloads are tiered by availability target. Tier 1 (99.95% or higher) requires multi-region active-passive recovery with RPO 15 minutes and RTO 1 hour. Tier 2 (99.9%) requires cross-region backups with RPO 24 hours and RTO 8 hours. Tier 3 (below 99.9%) requires in-region backups.
requirements: Tier 1 (>=99.95%): multi-region active-passive, RPO 15 min, RTO 1 h, DR test twice per year.
Tier 2 (99.9%): cross-region backups, RPO 24 h, RTO 8 h, annual restore test.
Tier 3 (<99.9%): in-region backups, RPO 24 h, RTO 72 h.

standards.title: Third-party integration security
standards.statement: Integrations with external parties complete a vendor risk assessment, use authenticated and encrypted channels, store credentials in a secrets manager, and validate all inbound payloads.
requirements: Vendor risk assessment before production data exchange.
Credentials stored in Secrets Manager (SVC-SECRETS) with rotation.
Validate and size-limit inbound payloads; rate limit public endpoints.
Data processing agreement for confidential or restricted data shared with vendors.

standards.title: Legacy file transfer retirement
standards.statement: Plain FTP and unauthenticated file drops are prohibited. Use managed SFTP or API-based exchange.
requirements: No plain FTP.
Use SVC-TRANSFER (managed SFTP) or authenticated APIs.

controls.description: Every component maps to an approved catalog entry or a documented exception.

controls.title: No long-lived credentials
controls.description: Workloads use temporary role credentials; no IAM user keys.

controls.title: MFA for sensitive data
controls.description: Users accessing confidential or restricted data must use MFA.

controls.title: Session timeout
controls.description: Interactive sessions expire within 60 minutes for sensitive data.

controls.title: TLS 1.2+ everywhere
controls.description: All endpoints enforce TLS 1.2 or later with ACM certificates.

controls.title: Encryption at rest
controls.description: All data stores encrypted at rest.

controls.title: Customer-managed KMS keys
controls.description: Confidential and restricted data use customer-managed KMS keys with rotation.

controls.title: Structured logs with correlation IDs
controls.description: JSON logs carrying a correlation ID across all hops.

controls.title: 400-day audit retention
controls.description: Security and audit logs retained 400 days.

controls.title: Alarms and tracing
controls.description: Error-rate and latency alarms plus distributed tracing.

controls.title: Privacy impact assessment
controls.description: PIA approved before production processing of personal data.

controls.title: Masked non-production data
controls.description: Personal data masked or tokenized outside production.

controls.title: Log redaction
controls.description: Personal data redacted from logs; residual streams retained <=30 days.

controls.title: AI use-case registration
controls.description: Use case registered with the Responsible AI Council before launch.

controls.title: Human accountability and advisory labeling
controls.description: AI output labeled advisory; a named human owns decisions.

controls.title: Prompt-injection and content filtering

controls.title: Pre-release evaluation
controls.description: Offline evaluation set run and reviewed before each release.

controls.title: Tier-appropriate backups
controls.description: Backups configured to meet the tier RPO, with restore tests.

controls.description: Tier 1 workloads maintain a tested warm standby in a second region.

controls.title: Vendor risk assessment
controls.description: Completed vendor risk assessment before production data exchange.

controls.description: Partner credentials stored in Secrets Manager with rotation.

controls.description: Schema validation, size limits, and WAF rate limiting on partner-facing endpoints.
